name: Das Kopialbuch
summary:
The Kopialbuch places you in a real 16th-century house belonging to the Fugger family. As a scribe, you are awakened in the middle of the night by a scream. Your lover has vanished from your secret bedchamber.

As you investigate, you make a dreadful discovery: the Kopialbuch has been stolen!

Set out in pursuit of the thief who slipped away under cover of darkness...
